s: Dine rechitza beshabbat ubo y"g seipim: aseru chakamim lirchotz kol gupo o rubbo bechammin, ben im hem bikli ben im hem baqqarqa, apillu huchammu meereb shabbat, mippene habballanim shehayu mechimmin beshabbat veameru "meereb shabbat hechamnu". Veap al pi shello nechshedu yisrael al hashshabbatot lechallel bezadon, mikkol maqom hayu notenim etzim tachat hammayim tzonenim mibbeod yom samuk lachasheka, vehem mitbaarim veholekim kol hashshabbat umechammemim et hammayim shealehem, vedabar zeh asur mishshum gezera, shemma yishkach veyachteh baggechalim mishshechasheka. Lepikak, aseru lekol adam lirchotz bechammin, apillu shello bemerchatz shel habballanim. Vaapillu lishpok hammayim al gupo lehishtattep, sheen zo derek rechitza shebbammerchatz, sheshsham maknis gupo veebarayv betok hammayim. Vaapillu rochetz kol eber veeber lebaddo, velo rob gupo bebat achat, veap al pi ken lo chalequ chakamim bigzeratam, kevan sheal kol panim domeh qetzat lirchitza shebbammerchatz sherochetz kol gupo o rubbo. Abal muttar lirchotz bechammin panayv yadayv veraglayv o shear ebarim, kol sheeno rochetz rob gupo. Velaken bemaqom sheen sham minhag — muttar leishsha lilbosh lebanim beshabbat, ki enah tzerika lirchotz ella paneha shel matta uben yarkoteha, raq shettizzaher shello tirchatz babbeged, shello tabo lide sechita. Vekol zeh bechamme haur, abal bechamme teberya muttar lirchotz, apillu lehaknis kol gupo yachad betok hammayim, veen tzarik lomar betzonenim. Umikkol maqom, lo hittiru bechamme teberya ella keshehem baqqarqa, abal keshehem bikli — dinam kechamme haur, mippene shekkol shehu bikli — eno nikkar ben chamme haur lechamme teberya, veyesh ligzor al ellu mippene ellu:

Yesh omerim shello hittiru chamme teberya ella kesheen hammaqom meqoreh, abal im hammaqom meqoreh — asur, mippene shebba lide zea, veasur lehazzia beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veyesh omerim shemmuttar lehazzia bechamme teberya, shehare lo aseru et hazzea ella mishshum gezerat rechitza kemo sheyyitbaer, vekevan shemmuttar lirchotz bechamme teberya — kol shekken shemmuttar lehazzia bahem. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:

Ammat hammayim shel chamme teberya — asur lehamshik letokah apillu mibbeod yom silon shel tzonen upi hassilon yotze chutz laamma umemayv nishpakim leuqa shebbaqqarqa, veosin ken kede sheyyitchammemu mayim hallalu shebbassilon beobram derek haamma shel chammin, vahare zo keen hatmana bedabar hammosip hebel, shemmayim hallalu nitmenu betok haamma shel chamme teberya shehen niqraim dabar hammosip hebel, ukebar nitbaer besiman rn"z sheasur lehatmin bedabar hammosip hebel apillu mibbeod yom, veim abar vehitmin — asur. Velaken im abar vehimshik hassilon shel tzonen letok haamma — asurim hammayim hannishpakim mimmennu lauqa, ben birchitza ben bishtiyya, keillu huchammu beshabbat, sheasur apillu lirchotz bahem panayv yadayv veraglayv, vaapillu eber echad bilbad. Veim himshik silon zeh beereb yom tob — dinam kechammin shehuchammu beyom tob, sheasur lirchotz bahem kol gupo o rubbo, abal muttarim bishtiyya o lirchotz bahem panayv yadayv veraglayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqy"a. Vekol zeh kesheggup hassilon muqqap mikkol tzad upiv yotze chutz laamma, abal im hu shopek hatztzonen letok haamma — en zeh niqra hatmana kelal, shehatztzonen mitareb hu bechammin velo nitman bo. Lepikak, muttar lehamshik hatztzonen mibbeod yom lesham vehu nimshak lesham veholek kol hashshabbat kullah. Veen bo mishshum bishshul, kevan shehitchil mibbeod yom vehu nigmar meelayv beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"b. Umuttar gam ken lirchotz apillu kol gupo beyachad beamma zo, kemo bishar chamme teberya:

Lo yishtattep adam betzonen kol gupo veyitchammem keneged hammedura, mippene shemmapshir mayim shealayv, venimtza kerochetz bechammin kol gupo. Abal muttar lehishtattep betzonen achar shennitchammem etzel haesh, mippene sheen hammayim shealayv mitchammemim kol kak. Veyesh omerim sheapillu harochetz yadayv tzarik lizzaher shello lechammemam keneged hammedura, apillu bemaqom sheen hayyad soledet bo, im lo yenaggebem techilla yapeh, mippene shemmapshir hammayim shealehen, venimtza kerochetz bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat. Vechammin shehuchammu beshabbat apillu behetter — asur lirchotz bahem apillu eber echad, vaapillu lo huchammu ella meat sheen hayyad soledet bo. Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem:

Mi shechash bemeayv — asur litten al gabbe bitno keli sheyyesh bo mayim chammin, shemma yishshapeku al rob gupo venimtza kerochetz rob gupo bechammin. Vaapillu im hem mayim muatim sheen bahem kede rechitzat rob gupo, mikkol maqom im huchammu beshabbat apillu meat sheen hayyad soledet bo — asur, kemo shennitbaer. Vaapillu bechol asur laasot ken, mippene hassakkana, sheppeamim shehammayim rotechim. Abal muttar lehachem beged velitteno al gabbe bitno, vaapillu beshabbat:

Harochetz bannahar — tzarik sheyyenaggeb gupo yapeh kesheoleh mehannahar, shello yishshaaru hammayim alayv vitaltelem arba ammot bekarmelit, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"a. Veod tzarik [lizzaher] shello lashut gupo bannahar, vegam shello lehashit shum dabar, kegon haqqissemin sheal pene hammayim asur lehaptzilan lekan ulekan lenaqqot hammayim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shl"t. Veod tzarik lizzaher kol rochetz shello lischot searo. Veap shello shayyak sechita besear, shehassear qasheh veeno bolea hammayim betoko mammash, mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim. Umippene sheen hakkol yodeim lizzaher bekol zeh, laken nitpashshet hamminhag bimdinot ellu shello lirchotz kelal beshabbat apillu betzonen, ap al pi sheen issur bedabar min haddin:

Adam muttar litbol mittumato beshabbat, apillu hatztzarik tebila min hattora, kegon nidda vekayyotze bahem, mippene sheeno nireh kimtaqqen ella keyored lehaqer. Vaapillu tobel bemayim seruchim sheen derek lehaqer bahem, vaapillu bimot haggeshamim sheen derek lehaqer kelal, mikkol maqom peamim sheadam meluklak betit vetzoa, verochetz apillu bimot haggeshamim vaapillu bemayim seruchim kede lehaabir hattit vehatztzoa mealayv. Ubimdinot ellu nahagu leesor tebilat ishsha beshabbat, ella im ken yesh balah bair vegam lo haya epshar lah litbol qodem hashshabbat, o shello haya balah bair uba beereb shabbat, shello posha bemah shello tobla qodem laken. Abal kol shehaya balah bair vehaya epshar lah litbol velo tobla — enah tobelet beshabbat. Veyesh shennatenu taam lamminhag, shekkevan shennitpashshet hamminhag shello lirchotz beshabbat, im ken keshettame tobel mittumato — hare zeh nireh kimtaqqen velo keyored lehaqer, kevan sheen derek kelal lirchotz lehaqer mittaam shennitbaer, ap al pi sheen issur bedabar. Umikkol maqom, muttar litbol leqeri, shekkevan shettebila zo enah min hattora (veap lo chiyyub gamur middibre soperim — eno nireh kimtaqqen. Veken hammumar sheshshab bitshuba muttar litbol beshabbat, sheen tebilato min hattora kemo tebilat hagger (veap en chiyyub gamur middibre soperim). Veken kol ishsha shetztzerika lachazor velitbol lechumra bealma — mutteret litbol beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman qatz"[z]):

Muttar lirchotz panayv yadayv veraglayv bidbarim sheenam mashshirim sear meorabim im debarim hammashshirim, ubilbad shello yehe harob middabar shemmashshir bevadday beinyan shehu "pesiq resheh velo yamut":

Muttar lirchotz yadayv bemursan, mippene shehu gibbul kilachar yad. Veap al pi sheyyesh lehachamir shello legabbel al yede shinnuy beshabbat ella im ken natan hammayim meereb shabbat, kemo shennitbaer besiman shk"d, mikkol maqom kan sheeno noten mayim mammash al hammursan ella shelloqecho beyadayim retubbot — muttar ledibre hakkol:

Asur lirchotz yadayv bemelach, vekol shekken beborit o shear cheleb, mippene shennimmoach al yado, vahare zeh kemolid beshabbat, vedomeh limlaka, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"k, sheasur lerasseq sheleg o barad mittaam zeh. Uledibre haomerim shettaam issur lerasseq sheleg ubarad hu mishshum gezerat sechitat perot haomedim lemashqin, sheap hashsheleg vehabbarad lememehem hem omedim, kemo shennitbaer sham, im ken borit ushear cheleb sheenan omedim lemashqin — muttar lerasseq lekattechilla. Abal yesh lehachamir kasbara harishona:

Merchatz shehaur nissoqet mibbachutz mittachtayv, im satemu meereb shabbat otan hanneqabim shehammerchatz mitchammem al yado — muttar lirchotz bo bemotzae shabbat miyyad, shehare lo nitchammem kelal beshabbat. Abal im lo satemu neqabayv meereb shabbat, ap al pi shemmeelayv hucham beshabbat — tzarik lehamtin laereb bikde sheyyeasu, lepi shehucham beissur, sheasur lihyot neqabayv petuchim beshabbat kesheyyesh esh tachtayv, gezera shemma yachteh baggechalim:

Aseru chakamim likkanes lammerchatz apillu lehazzia bilbad, mippene obere abera shehayu rochatzin bechammin veameru "mazziin anachnu". Veyesh omerim sheapillu laabor bammerchatz bemaqom sheyyakol lehazzia asur, ap al pi sheeno mitkavven lekak:

Ir shayisrael venokrim darim bah veyesh bah merchatz rochetzet beshabbat, im rob nokrim — muttar lirchotz bah lemotzae shabbat miyyad, shemmin hassetam huchamma beshabbat bishbil hannokrim shehem harob. Veim rubbah yisrael — tzarik lehamtin ad kede sheyyucham. Vaapillu bemechetza al mechetza tzarik lehamtin ken, lepi shemmin hassetam huchamma beshabbat bishbil shenehem:
